description: Builds an UNSIGNED MultiversX swap transaction for `sender` to sign with its own wallet. The transaction is verified and rebuilt from verified fields only (receiver = hard-coded OneDex aggregator, or the allowlisted XOXNO router after strict route decoding, capped gas, gasPrice 1e9). Returns the transaction, a human-readable summary, costs, warnings, expiresAt (advisory; minOut is the on-chain protection) and `signingLink`: a MultiversX Web Wallet URL (wallet.multiversx.com/hook/transaction) with this exact transaction pre-filled, for a human to open, check receiver/amount/token on the wallet screen and confirm there. This server never signs or holds keys.

amountIn.description: Amount of tokenIn as a decimal string, e.g. "1.5" (not base units)

confirmHighImpact.description: Must be true to accept price impact above 10%, or when the aggregator-based and independent (api.multiversx.com) impacts disagree by more than 5 points

confirmHighSlippage.description: Must be true to accept slippage above 5%

network.description: MultiversX network (default mainnet; devnet only if configured)

sender.description: Bech32 address (erd1…) of the wallet that will sign

slippageBps.description: Slippage in basis points (100 = 1%, default). Above 500 needs confirmHighSlippage: true; above 2000 is refused.

tokenIn.description: "EGLD", a token identifier like "ONE-f9954f", or a unique ticker like "USDC"

tokenOut.description: "EGLD", a token identifier like "ONE-f9954f", or a unique ticker like "USDC"

name: build_swap_tx
title: Build an UNSIGNED swap transaction
